findings.before: 부실에서 쿄카와 마나미가 만화에 영향을 받아 장기를 둔다. 첫날부터 의욕을 낼 줄 알았던 모모세가 볼일이 있다며 먼저 돌아갔다는 말에 주인공이 의아해한다.
findings.after: 부실에서 만화에 영향을 받은 쿄카가 마나미와 장기를 둔다. 첫날부터 의욕을 낼 줄 알았던 모모세가 볼일이 있다며 먼저 돌아갔다는 말에 주인공이 의아해한다.
findings.reason: Only Kyoka is the one influenced by the manga (borrowed from Manami); the summary gave the influence to both.

findings.after: 주인공이 마나미에게 같은 반인 모모세가 요즘 어떤지 묻는다. 머리색을 되돌린 뒤 의외로 인기가 많고 정갈한 차림 탓에 마마보이일지 모른다는 이야기에 주인공이 웃는다.

findings.reason: Source says Momose has grown taller; the ambiguous adnominal reads as tall, which contradicts the short-Momose gag in this scene.

considered_not_changed.why: Group support generalised to everyone; one member defers rather than supports, nobody objects. Acceptable.
Club room not named in the scene, but the arrival greeting and stage 3 of the same card place it there.
Running home is implied by the recording he must catch; left as a reasonable reading.
Almost-laughing rests on the other character's question; the second sentence carries the real point. Left.

unresolved.why: Branch 1 (E00805) has Momose paying Izumi the same compliment directly; in branch 2 Izumi was alone with him. Installed Korean uses the same word as the summary.
Leaving out the explicit passage is right. The villains' closing oath is story-relevant; adding it means shortening the two existing sentences. Current text is not a defect under a-g.
Payday is Manami's own word, and she uses it again in E00101; the allowance idea is only the protagonist's inner guess.
